literature_notes: The single ledger line (L1) describes a GluK1-SP_GluK2 construct cloned into pEZT-BM and fused in-frame via a thrombin recognition site to mVenus and a Twin-Strep affinity tag. The pEZT-BM vector (Morales-Perez et al., 2016) appends tags C-terminally; the phrasing 'fused in frame … to mVenus and a Twin-Strep affinity tag' confirms the tag follows the GluK1 coding sequence. GluK1's C-terminus (residue 918) lies in the intracellular domain IC2 (856–918), so this is an intracellular tag used for baculovirus-based membrane-protein purification and cryo-EM, not an extracellular surface tag. No ledger line reports an insertion at the extracellular N-terminus (after SP cleavage at residue 30/31), in the large EC1 domain (31–577), or in the EC2 loop (675–834). Because no ledger line grounds an extracellular tag site, zero sites are reported.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal mVenus + Twin-Strep fusion (via thrombin site) in pEZT-BM baculovirus vector; residue 918 is in the intracellular C-terminal domain IC2 (856–918), so the tag faces the cytoplasm, not the cell surface.
